compiler_policy_corrections.historical_reason: Compiler-generated base-object destructor. dScEntry_c declares its destructor out of line, so mwccarm emits all three variants; under this file's `#pragma defer_codegen off` the group emits D1, D0, D2, and D1/D0 reproduce the cartridge byte for byte at 0x02115ab8 and 0x02115b28. Nothing in the object references D2: the vtable's slots 16 and 17 name D1 and D0. config/arm9/overlays/*/symbols.txt gives _ZN10dScEntry_cD2Ev no home anywhere in the ROM, which is the cartridge saying the retail link dead-stripped the same unreferenced variant. Homeless, so a plain deadstrip rather than deadstrip-duplicate.

Compiler-generated base-object constructor variant for the nested graphCallback_c. The cartridge defines only the complete-object C1 at 0x021160b4; graphCallback_c is never constructed as a base subobject, so no C2 exists in the ROM.

Compiler-generated deleting destructor variant for the nested icon_c. icon_c instances live only as the 9-element array member at dScEntry_c+0x70 and are destroyed as an array, never individually deleted, so the cartridge never emitted a D0 for it.

Compiler-generated base-object destructor variant for the nested icon_c. The cartridge defines only _ZN10dScEntry_c6icon_cD1Ev (0x02115bac); no symbols.txt in the tree defines a D2 and nothing relocates to one.
Compiler-generated base-object destructor variant for OamAnimation. The cartridge defines only _ZN12OamAnimationD1Ev (0x02115bc8); no D2 exists in the ROM.
